name.value: Chan Centre for the Performing Arts

description.value: Chan Shun Concert Hall is the centrepiece of the Chan Centre for the Performing Arts at the University of British Columbia, celebrated internationally for its cello-inspired design and stellar acoustics since opening in 1997. The hall seats concertgoers beneath a striking 22.7-tonne adjustable acoustic canopy and has hosted artists from Jeremy Dutcher to Jon Batiste. Located on the scenic UBC campus along cycling-friendly routes, it is reachable by bike with dedicated racks steps from the main entrance.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (12 spaces) at 38m; stands (8 spaces) at 63m; rack (covered) at 80m. Total: 20 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Chan Shun Concert Hall is a world-class concert venue within the Chan Centre for the Performing Arts at UBC, open since 1997. The directions page explicitly states bike racks are available: 'The closest bike rack to the Chan Centre is located on Crescent Road in between East Mall and the flagpole plaza.' No evidence was found for water refill, washrooms (despite being implied for a venue), or most other amenities. Address and website are confirmed by the website; OSM has no phone but the website lists the ticket office number 604-822-2697.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; phone 604-822-2697 sourced from website ticket office contact page
OSM street name includes Indigenous name 'Crescent Road - xʷsel̓c̓əχən̓' while website uses only 'Crescent Road' or 'Crescent Rd'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A premier performing arts venue on the UBC campus with confirmed bike parking and easy cycling access, making it a worthwhile cultural attraction for touring cyclists visiting Vancouver.
